Round 4: identified from Youngs 1907; wife of Rev. John Youngs, not ancestral.

bio: Mary (Warren), widow Gardner, daughter of Thomas Warren of Southwold, was Rev. John Youngs's third wife, probably married at Salem about 1639. She died at Southold in 1678 ([R4-S1]). Not ancestral.
sources: [R4-S1] Selah Youngs Jr., Youngs Family: Vicar Christopher Yonges, his ancestors in England and his descendants in America (1907), pp. 38-41 (First and Second Generations) (secondary) https://archive.org/details/youngsfamilyvica00youn
